sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 160. Success value 100. 5x physical damage (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 160. Success value 100. 5x magic damage (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies a pressure state (prohibits switching with any surviving player in a Guild Battle) for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Slumber for 40 seconds with a success value of 100.
-Target: all enemies. Increases Ability cooldown times by 50% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces Unison gauge gains by 3 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Cost recovery speed reduced by 10 for 90 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Armament for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases ATK and MATK by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).

-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 260. Success value 100. 5x magic damage (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Reduces physical/magic damage taken to 0 (7 times). Effect applied for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Reduces physical/magic damage taken to 0 (1 time).
-Target: all allies. Reduces physical/magic damage taken to 0 (2 times).
-Target: all allies. Reduces fixed damage taken to 0 (1 time only).
-Target: all allies. Recovers 75% of max CP.
-Target: all allies. Applies dual attack, reducing the cooldown time of the next Ability used to 0 (except for certain Abilities).
-Target: all allies. Applies iron wall for 100 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Redoubt for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] reduces physical/magic damage by 50%; nullifies fixed damage; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies status ailments. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 20000
Increases your wind elemental Unison damage Ability Power by 30.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 20000

[Floral Fawn Symbiotic Pair] Ryne & Nym or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
